purpose: Read-only planning layer that compares the live estate snapshot with the latest persisted timeline entry before any new timeline append.
rules: The current Estate Audit Timeline must verify before planning.
The live candidate manifest must verify and use an asOf strictly later than the latest persisted timeline entry.
The canonical Estate Manifest Diff is retained in full.
exportSha256 changes are reported separately as snapshot-hash changes because per-app audit exports bind asOf and therefore naturally change as time advances.
Any changed item with an unrecognised diff dimension, malformed change list or unrecognised item status is unsupported_change and requires human review before any timeline action.
Unknown diff semantics must never be silently downgraded to snapshot_hash_only or no_change.
material_change means at least one added/removed app or at least one changed non-exportSha256 manifest dimension.
snapshot_hash_only means app membership and all material dimensions are unchanged while one or more exportSha256 values changed.
no_change means the canonical diff reports no changed dimensions at all.
The planner never appends a timeline entry and never invokes the timeline apply action.
A material_change recommendation is descriptive only; explicit timeline --apply remains required.
nonClaims: snapshot_hash_only does not prove nothing anywhere changed; it means the compact manifest exposes no material identity-dimension change beyond time-sensitive per-app audit hashes.
material_change is not a severity or risk judgement.
The planner does not decide whether a historical snapshot should be retained for governance or external recordkeeping.
unsupported_change does not mean the change is unsafe; it means the current planner contract cannot classify it safely without explicit review.
